checks.evidence: tight-s34-4.png clearly shows a qamatz under the shin: 'מִפְּנֵי שֶׁהוּא עוֹשָׂה פֶּחָם'. The masculine subject שֶׁהוּא requires the masculine participle עוֹשֶׂה, which is the standard Mishnah reading. עוֹשָׂה would be the feminine participle, and a real feminine variant would also need שֶׁהִיא, which this page does not print. So this is an obvious typesetting error in the source, not a different textual tradition. bameh_madlikin.xml:34 has <tei:choice><tei:sic>עוֹשָׂה</tei:sic><tei:corr>עוֹשֶׂה</tei:corr></tei:choice>: the printed form is kept as sic and the fix goes in corr. That is correct. No other choice/sic/corr appears in the changed files.
